records.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources
certified_facts: A voluntary team of experts had constituted a Technical Drought Committee since the prior year.
The committee advised DRNA and other agencies during the drought.
A proposed change in minimum inflow was to be brought to the committee for consideration that week.
not_certified: whether every agency response followed a committee recommendation
records.epistemic_use: Certifies committee existence and advisory function only; does not establish institutional-memory completeness.

records.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources
certified_facts: DRNA described a monitoring metric based on four USGS-operated sentinel wells for southern aquifers.
The public-facing condition scale comprised optimal, observation, controls-and-adjustments, and critical states.
The notice treated aquifer conditions separately from reservoir conditions.
not_certified: identities of all four sentinel wells from this notice alone
numeric threshold for each condition state
mapping between USGS parameter codes and each threshold
records.epistemic_use: Primary lead for recovering official groundwater operating thresholds; no threshold may be inferred from the category labels alone.
